message:
Open the new-comment form in a box under the selected line

Generalize the thread zone hook into useLineZones and use it a second time for the
new-comment form, so the form shows inside the file like review threads do.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main' into mpl-97-inline-comment-form

# Conflicts:
#	src/renderer/src/card/viewer/FileViewer.tsx

Move the cursor through moveCursor in the new-selection form test

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Put the cursor in the new comment box when Comment is pressed

Focus the form's text box once its zone is placed, and build the form list from the
file path so a file reload does not pull focus back to the form.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Focus the new comment box once the editor shows its zone

Monaco adds a view zone hidden and shows it on its next render, so focusing the box right
after adding the zone did nothing. Wait until the box has a size, then focus it.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
